before.text: The family and its members are plan items, and Aggregation Relationships (cprpd3110m000), Planning ➔ Master Data ➔ Items ➔ Aggregation Relationships, holds a row for each member: Aggregate from Sub-Item with a Demand Forecast percentage, or Disaggregate to Sub-Item with a Production Plan percentage.

tokens.v: A family is a plan item that stands for a group of items. Its aggregation relationships say which members' figures roll up to it and in what share, and which sub-families take a share of its plan back. Aggregating copies the members' forecasts up; planning the family makes one production plan for the whole group; disaggregating splits that plan down again.
